# Repository Content To Site

Classify content as PUBLIC or INTERNAL before rendering. Ground claims in files. Never expose operational secrets, private records, or personal data simply because they are in a repo.

Read the repository assessment and current site manifest. Record evidence and changes in docs/site-builder/work-log.md. Continue to the next stage unless an actual external authorization boundary remains.
